name: EC62 Phuket (Edge Centres)
notes: DCD reported on 2022-08-24 that Edge Centres would deploy EC61 Chiang Mai, EC62 Phuket and EC63 Khon Kaen, each with just under 1MW of solar infrastructure, 48-hour battery/UPS and 64 x 1kW quarter racks; Baxtel currently lists EC62 Phuket as operational (year built 2023) on Montri Rd, Phuket. IT/power capacity not officially disclosed, so capacity_mw is null.

name: Phuket Data Center (KeFF Networks)
notes: AzireVPN's blog describes renting rackspace in the Phuket Data Center facility with network upstream and hosting services of KeFF Networks (AS41281), indicating an operating colocation/edge facility in Phuket; no official facility page, capacity, or address found, so confidence is aggregate/third-party only.

name: Phuket AI data centre business permits (aggregate)
notes: Bangkok Post (2026-08-05) reports the Ministry of Commerce issued 1,145 AI data centre business permits, 669 in Bangkok and the remainder scattered across Nonthaburi, Pathum Thani, Phuket, Chon Buri, Nakhon Ratchasima, Rayong and Khon Kaen; this confirms Phuket hosts some AI data-centre businesses but no named facility, capacity, or site was found.
